result.description: AI meeting recorder that records, transcribes and summarizes video calls (Zoom, Meet, Teams) and exposes the meeting data via API.
result.auth_detail: Per-user API key (X-Api-Key header) generated in User Settings → API Access; OAuth 2.0 for apps other Fathom users install (Bearer token). Per FAQ, OAuth apps can't use include_summary/include_transcript on /meetings.
result.access_detail: API keys and webhooks are included on all plans (including free); generate key in User Settings → API Access. Keys are per user, no org-level keys. OAuth app registration process for third parties not verified in docs (marketplace/registered app per third-party sources).
result.api_notes: REST at https://api.fathom.ai/external/v1. Endpoints: GET /meetings, recording summary/transcript, recording download (POST) and download status, /teams, /team_members, /users, /meeting_types, webhook create/delete. Mostly read-only. TypeScript and Python SDKs. Rate limit 60 calls/60s; heavy endpoints 30/60s.

evidence.quote: Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more.
All REST API resources are authenticated with API keys generated via the Fathom website's settings area.
Use **OAuth** if you’re building an app that other Fathom users will install so they can connect their own accounts.
Yes. API access—keys and webhooks— are included on all plans. Generate a key in User Settings → API Access.
